kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw delete-control-policy --source-ip 192.0.XX.XX --lang zh --acl-uuid 00281255-d220-4db1-8f4f-c4df221ad84c --direction in --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the traffic
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the access control policy.

To delete an access control policy, you must provide the unique ID of the policy. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138866.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

删除安全访问控制策略，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138866.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction controlled by the access control policy.

Valid values:

- **in**: inbound traffic.
- **out**: outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略管控的流量方向。

取值：

- **in**：流量从外到内。
- **out**：流量从内到外
parameters.name: direction
